Flying the all new Freewing F-35C RC Jet! Hear that 110mm EDF ROAR! The biggest Jet that Freewing makes is a heavy, and large bird, but it’s graceful in the sky. This is a video of my second flight ever. Love the formation lights and afterburner. The sound is fantastic. Handles a bit more sensitive and temperamental than the F-22, but still a blast to fly. Landing gear handles the grass runway like it’s absolutely nothing. Even took my Navy landings pretty well.. haha. #radiocontrol #remotecontrol #f35 #fighterjet #rchobby
